svg.text: Rows: historical GPT-6 Astra FULL; K−S−, K+S−, K−S+; current GPT-5.6 Sol FULL (K+S+). Columns: T01–T10 and PHS-2D.
Each panel is normalized independently within each task; values are relative resource use, not performance scores. Raw totals are reported in Table III.
† Astra token counts are estimated. K+S− T06 token count is imputed from the other T06 cells. Sol FULL token usage is a recorded lower bound.
